independence_boundary: This review evaluates the rebuilt registry and live renderer. For structures/tree and OOP/files remediation artifacts, it relies on the named independent PASS reviews and does not re-review content authored by this reviewer.

checks.name: worked-example requirement → design → Python → trace → output/tests → evidence chain

evidence.failure_mode: The affected scalar worked-example blocks describe an example but do not expose all seven contract elements, especially executable Python, explicit tests and evidence.

checks.name: guided → faded → independent practice with hint, feedback and authored rubric

evidence.failure_mode: The affected scalar practice blocks name activities but do not provide per-item hints, reveal conditions, feedback/repair or an authored rubric.

checks.name: retrieval reconstruction, diagnosis, repair and self-assessment

evidence.failure_mode: The affected retrieval prompts are concrete but do not provide an explicit hidden-answer/reveal contract and authored self-assessment rubric.

checks.name: live renderer can render structured locale payloads

evidence.code_location: LessonLearningPage.tsx: humaniseKey(key) is locale-agnostic and ContentValue does not receive locale

evidence.note: Lack of authority in thirteen other lessons is reported separately and is not counted as an invented numeric mark claim.

findings.title: Thirteen worked examples still do not implement the full Stage 0 chain
findings.evidence: Each affected worked-example is a scalar explanatory paragraph. None exposes the complete bilingual requirement, design, Python, trace, expected output, tests and evidence contract that the renderer can present and the learner can verify.
findings.required_correction: Author a complete worked example for every affected lesson with a concrete fixture and requirement, explicit design, runnable Python or clearly identified pseudocode, step trace, expected output, normal/boundary/failure tests as applicable, and evidence references. Rebuild the registry and require 26/26 complete chains.

findings.title: Thirteen lessons still lack assessable practice and retrieval repair loops
findings.evidence: Practice text may name guided, faded and independent activities, but it does not carry stable assessment items with fixtures, expected learner artifacts, hints, reveal rules, feedback/repair and authored rubrics. Retrieval prompts lack an explicit hidden-answer/reveal and self-assessment contract.
findings.required_correction: Add stable guided, faded and independent practice items with fixtures, expected artifacts, localized hints, reveal conditions, misconception-specific feedback and AlgoCore-authored rubrics. Add retrieval reconstruction or trace-repair items with hidden answers, diagnosis, repair and rubric. Rebuild and require 26/26 coverage.

findings.title: Thirteen mark-protection blocks still lack a verified QP/MS or explicit authored-rubric join
findings.evidence: Their marking-pitfalls blocks contain useful warnings but their source references contain neither both QP and MS authorities nor AlgoCore_authored_rubric. The requirement → mark/rubric → method → error → detection → repair chain is therefore not auditable.
findings.required_correction: Join each warning to verified QP/MS atoms when available. Otherwise add an explicitly labelled AlgoCore-authored rubric. Preserve requirement, method step, error, detection and repair without inventing numeric Cambridge marks.

findings.title: Vietnamese pages render English nested field labels
findings.evidence: LessonLearningPage.ContentValue renders object keys through locale-agnostic humaniseKey(key). Vietnamese pages therefore display learner-facing labels such as requirement, design, expectedOutput, practiceItems, hint, feedback and rubric in English even when nested values are correctly localized.
findings.required_correction: Pass locale into ContentValue and map every learner-facing structural key to VI/EN labels, or store localized display labels in the registry. Add a rendered VI lesson assertion covering workedExample, practiceItems, retrievalItem and markingChain labels.

findings.title: The deterministic pedagogy verifier deep-checks only half of the registry
findings.evidence: PEDAGOGY_DETERMINISTIC_VERIFICATION.json reports PASS, but its own scope declares all_lessons_locale_check=26 and remediated_lessons_deep_check=13. The thirteen excluded lessons are exactly the lessons failing the final worked/practice/retrieval/marking checks.
findings.required_correction: Extend verify-stage9-pedagogy.mjs so worked example, practice, retrieval, marking authority, static fallback and nested locale checks run over all 26 lessons. A final PASS requires deep scope 26 and zero required findings.
